sources.note: Nothing. Entry 230 reads: '1.A Kaibi / 3. Kaduna State, Saminaka LGA / 4. 650 (NAT 1949) / 5. no data. Benue-Congo: Kainji: Eastern Kainji: Kauru subgroup' -- i.e. the atlas explicitly records that no linguistic data exist.
